content.text: Now let's run the JSON driver against the golden example fixtures:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'audit')
from audit import audit
for name in ["empty", "compact", "fullwidth", "invalid"]:
    payload = open(f"examples/{name}.in.json","rb").read()
    expected = json.load(open(f"examples/{name}.out.json"))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd="/workspace")
    print("==", name, "rc", p.returncode, "stderr", p.stderr[:300])
    actual = json.loads(p.stdout)
    try:
        request = json.loads(payload)
    except ValueError:
        request = None
    try:
        audit(request, actual, expected)
        print("   AUDIT PASS, objective:", [c["objective"] for c in actual.get("cases", [])] if "cases" in actual else actual)
    except ValueError as e:
        print("   AUDIT FAIL:", e)
        print(json.dumps(actual)[:2000])
EOF
